messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@brightforge.com>, partners@brightforge.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner Integration Lab: curated hands-on tracks & readiness checkpoint

Hi Anita / BrightForge team —

Thanks again for committing to the joint Integration Lab (Wk of Sep 14). Attached is the first draft of the lab syllabus and the sandbox access doc. The goal here is to run two concurrent hands-on tracks over three half-day sessions:

- Track A: Production-serving pipelines (Redwood Dedicated + CI/CD for model flips)
- Track B: App-level integrations (chat + function calling + structured output)

What Im proposing:
1) Pre-lab checklist (week before): sandbox access, sample credentials, minimal Terraform infra applied
2) Day 1 (half day): architecture walkthrough + infra setup (both tracks)
3) Day 2 (half day): hands-on labs per track (split rooms)
4) Day 3 (half day): end-to-end validation + smoke tests + quality rubric

Trainers: Marissa will lead Track A (serving/runtime), Soojin will lead Track B (app patterns). Tessa will handle environment support and scoring.

Please confirm the attendee list (we expect 6 BrightForge engineers), any dietary restrictions for in-person lunch, and whether you want the lab recorded for internal enablement.

Attachments: redwood-integration-lab-syllabus-v1.pdf (syllabus), bf-sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (step-by-step access), sample-terraform-infra.zip (example infra templates).

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com

From: Anita Rao <anita@brightforge.com>

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Partner Integration Lab: curated hands-on tracks & readiness checkpoint

Thanks Avery — this looks great. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Attendees: confirmed 5 engineers plus our Solutions Architect (Jared Mills). Can you add Jared to the access list?
2) Sandbox VPC: our security team asks whether the sandbox will egress to the internet during lab activities. We prefer isolated egress where possible; can Tessa confirm network posture?
3) Recording: wed prefer recordings turned off for the session focused on customer-sensitive data patterns. Fine to record the architecture overview.

Also, on Day 2 Track B we have a small demo (BrightForge connector) that requires an additional service account with write access to a sample S3 bucket. Can you add guidance into the infra bundle (or point to a minimal IAM policy)?

Can we do a 30-minute prep call on Thu Sep 10 to validate sandbox accounts and trainer slides?

—Anita
Anita Rao
Head of Integrations, BrightForge Solutions
Anita.Rao@brightforge.com

Thanks Anita — tagging the items below and confirming ownership: 

- Jared Mills: please send his email and I'll add to the sandbox ACLs (owner: Marissa).
- Sandbox egress: Tessa — can you confirm we will provide a restricted NAT that blocks outbound except to package registries and Redwood telemetry endpoints? If so we'll document it in bf-sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (owner: Tessa).
- S3 service account & IAM: Soojin will add a minimal IAM policy into sample-terraform-infra.zip (owner: Soojin). Policy will be labeled: bf-demo-s3-writer-policy.json.
- Prep call: Thu Sep 10, 10:00am PT works for us — Avery to send calendar invite and dial-in.

I'll also add a short evaluation rubric to the syllabus (success criteria for "smoke tests" and expected artifacts from BrightForge by workshop end).

Quick logistics note: we plan to run the sessions in a hybrid format — please indicate the number of in-person seats (we can host up to 8 Redwoods + partners in SF HQ).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
